0.q: expression of CNH1 confers upon B31 cells tolerance to high Na+ concentrations, presumably by performing the function of the Sacch. cerevisiae NHA1.
We have recently shown that C. albicans Cnh1p transports, besides toxic sodium and lithium, also potassium and rubidium.

1.q: We have identified a single copy of the GPP orthologous gene (GPP1) in the C. albicans haploid genome, as well as the paralogous gene 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate phosphatase (DOG1); both belong to a family of low molecular weight phosphatases.
